verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents an official MCP server that AI clients like Claude Code and Codex connect to. Through it an agent can change the Model's Pages, Tables, formulas and Variables, and the docs give 'update this month's forecast' as an example. Every Model change is recorded in the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone, because clients sign in and act as that person, so agent edits land in the same audit trail as human ones. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP write path and changelog behavior, and an explicit MCP tool for creating scenarios (scenarios appear reachable only indirectly, by handing a request to Ari via edit_chats).
